text: Coarse-grained force fields like MARTINI map roughly one bead to one heavy atom, making simulations only marginally faster than fully atomistic MD.
explanation: This is false on both counts: MARTINI maps approximately four heavy atoms to a single bead, not one-to-one, and this coarse-graining yields simulations that are roughly 100 to 1000 times faster than atomistic MD, far more than a marginal speedup.
